index.description: F1-ennustuspeli: Finnish original questions, historical score audit, player answers and bingo cards.
limitations: Right/wrong/partial verdicts are markings transcribed from the source PowerPoints and workbook, not independently checked against live Formula 1 data.
Player scores are verified values in Vastaukset. No automatic rescore of text predictions is performed.
2026 has questions but no player answers or results in the supplied workbook.
The workbook records a limitation for the 2020 retirements question; the documented points are retained.
All-time points are sums of verified individual question scores; equal question scores produce shared countback placements.
Maximum points for completed seasons 2020–2025 are user-confirmed; season and career percentages are derived from those values.
